artifact: First Case Arm Assignment and Blinding Plan
expert_eligibility_minimum: Qualified professional with nutrition/dietetics or relevant clinical nutrition decision expertise appropriate to the task.
Able to make independent professional judgments under incomplete information.
No prior exposure to this exact case in another R1 workflow arm.
No access to hidden diet values, final reference, other experts' answers or meta-audit labels.
Conflict-of-interest and prior-case-exposure status recorded before binding.
identity_binding_rule: Real identities are bound only after qualification/exposure screening; P0 does not invent expert identities.
randomization_status: NOT_INFERENTIAL_WITH_ONE_CASE; slot structure frozen, multi-case randomization deferred until R1a stress slice expands.
